proof.program_space: 16 G Boolean gates x 16 H Boolean gates x XOR/AND/OR = 768 latent programs
proof.latent_nonidentifiability: 656 of 768 program memberships have a realized table shared with other latent programs; maximum 54 syntactic programs realize a single truth table.
proof.training: 64 fresh source-free public partial rule observation fixtures per prior, 4 input patterns observed, 3 public EM iterations per equally trained compositional, joint 768 and full 256 control; source-private atom identities never supplied to training.
proof.independent_oracle_check: Direct 768-program-weight conditional inference equals an independently aggregated 256-rule posterior in each of 9 prior-by-observation regimes
proof.uniform_full_rule_negative_control: Exact conditional mutual information zero; oracle expected Brier 0.25 for each unseen bit under k=2,4,6

scientific_interpretation.why_not_scientific_firstuse: The results are analytic expected outcomes under assumed program priors and public-only source-free fitting, not independently originated unfamiliar causal tasks or an actual measured full CPU/RSS advantage. Oracle gain is an information upper bound unavailable to actual model training.
scientific_interpretation.exposure_caveat: First 32 public TRAIN fixtures are forced-stratified to cover every 16-value G/H atom role. This is source-free fixture coverage, not an IID training draw from private source priors and not evidence of actual new-world generalization.
scientific_interpretation.importance: Rather than recycle Gaussian or cached inference representations, test learnable compositional-vs-unrestricted model selection under source shift and genuinely unfamiliar operator graphs; require clear OOD calibration and efficiency parity.
